comment: Pairs of {open-source repo, page built from it} for measuring how much visible text is literal in the source (TDD s0.5, gating anchor search s5.3). Chosen to span the ways projects store user-visible text, because that - not framework - is what decides whether anchor search can locate a node: markdown content, component JSX/templates, and i18n catalogues. nodejs.org is the deliberate i18n case: its text lives in locale JSON, so a hit there proves the string exists but not where it is rendered. Sizes are measured at clone time and recorded in results rather than asserted here.

entries.note: Homepage only. eslint.org renders its docs from the eslint/eslint repo at build time, so /docs/** text is absent from this checkout by design - measured and confirmed, not assumed.

entries.textStrategy: next.js: MDX docs + JSX marketing copy
